teaser: Run your own sgit server in your own AWS account and region, deployed from CI with the site factory's pattern: OIDC, no keys, checks first.
core_idea: A team can hold its own sgit ciphertext in its own account and region, and deploy the server repeatably from CI with OIDC, a protected environment, narrow trust, checks and teardown.

nodes.label: Your region
nodes.summary: Bucket named by account and region.

nodes.label: Check first
nodes.summary: Prove the setup before real runs.

quotes.text: Running your own server changes who holds the ciphertext and where.
There is no AWS access key in GitHub, so there is none to leak.
nobody should have to repeat it by hand

figures.caption: Your own sgit server: your devices encrypt, your account runs one image, your region holds the ciphertext.
The site factory pattern: protected environment, OIDC, narrow trust, least privilege, checks, teardown.
